verses.original: Λοιπὸν οὖν ἀδελφοί ἐρωτῶμεν ὑμᾶς καὶ παρακαλοῦμεν ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ ἵνα καθὼς παρελάβετε παρ’ ἡμῶν τὸ πῶς δεῖ ὑμᾶς περιπατεῖν καὶ ἀρέσκειν Θεῷ καθὼς καὶ περιπατεῖτε ἵνα περισσεύητε μᾶλλον
verses.transliteration: Loipon oun adelphoi erōtōmen hymas kai parakaloumen en Kyriō Iēsou hina kathōs parelabete par’ hēmōn to pōs dei hymas peripatein kai areskein Theō kathōs kai peripateite hina perisseuēte mallon
verses.literal: Finally . . . brothers we ask and encourage you in the Lord Jesus - to live in a way - that is pleasing to God just as you have received from us This is how . . . you already live so you should do so all the more

verses.original: οἴδατε γὰρ τίνας παραγγελίας ἐδώκαμεν ὑμῖν διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: oidate gar tinas parangelias edōkamen hymin dia tou Kyriou Iēsou
verses.literal: For you know the instructions we gave you by the authority of the Lord Jesus

verses.original: Τοῦτο γάρ ἐστιν θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ ἁγιασμὸς ὑμῶν ἀπέχεσθαι ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ τῆς πορνείας
verses.transliteration: Touto gar estin thelēma tou Theou ho hagiasmos hymōn apechesthai hymas apo tēs porneias
verses.literal: For it is God’s will that you should be holy You must abstain from sexual immorality

verses.original: εἰδέναι ἕκαστον ὑμῶν τὸ ἑαυτοῦ σκεῦος κτᾶσθαι ἐν ἁγιασμῷ καὶ τιμῇ
verses.transliteration: eidenai hekaston hymōn to heautou skeuos ktasthai en hagiasmō kai timē
verses.literal: each of you must know how to control his own body in holiness and honor

verses.original: μὴ ἐν πάθει ἐπιθυμίας καθάπερ καὶ τὰ ἔθνη τὰ μὴ εἰδότα τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: mē en pathei epithymias kathaper kai ta ethnē ta mē eidota ton Theon
verses.literal: not in lustful passion like . . . the Gentiles who do not know God

verses.original: τὸ μὴ ὑπερβαίνειν καὶ πλεονεκτεῖν ἐν τῷ πράγματι τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ διότι ἔκδικος Κύριος περὶ πάντων τούτων καθὼς καὶ προείπαμεν ὑμῖν καὶ διεμαρτυράμεθα
verses.transliteration: to mē hyperbainein kai pleonektein en tō pragmati ton adelphon autou dioti ekdikos Kyrios peri pantōn toutōn kathōs kai proeipamen hymin kai diemartyrametha
verses.literal: and no one should ever violate or exploit his brother in this regard because the Lord will avenge . . . all such acts as . . . we have already told you and solemnly warned you

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἐκάλεσεν ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς ἐπὶ ἀκαθαρσίᾳ ἀλλ’ ἐν ἁγιασμῷ
verses.transliteration: ou gar ekalesen hēmas ho Theos epi akatharsia all’ en hagiasmō
verses.literal: For God has not called us to impurity but to holiness

verses.original: τοιγαροῦν ὁ ἀθετῶν οὐκ ἄνθρωπον ἀθετεῖ ἀλλὰ τὸν Θεὸν τὸν καὶ διδόντα τὸ Πνεῦμα αὐτοῦ τὸ ἅγιον εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: toigaroun ho athetōn ouk anthrōpon athetei alla ton Theon ton kai didonta to Pneuma autou to hagion eis hymas
verses.literal: Anyone then who rejects this command does not reject man but God the very One who . . . gives you His Holy Spirit

verses.original: Περὶ δὲ τῆς φιλαδελφίας οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε γράφειν ὑμῖν αὐτοὶ γὰρ ὑμεῖς θεοδίδακτοί ἐστε εἰς τὸ ἀγαπᾶν ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: Peri de tēs philadelphias ou chreian echete graphein hymin autoi gar hymeis theodidaktoi este eis to agapan allēlous
verses.literal: Now about brotherly love you do not need anyone to write to you because you yourselves have been taught by God - to love one another

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ποιεῖτε αὐτὸ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς τοὺς ἐν ὅλῃ τῇ Μακεδονίᾳ Παρακαλοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί περισσεύειν μᾶλλον
verses.transliteration: kai gar poieite auto eis pantas tous adelphous tous en holē tē Makedonia Parakaloumen de hymas adelphoi perisseuein mallon
verses.literal: And you are indeed showing this love to all the brothers throughout . . . Macedonia But we urge you brothers to excel more and more

verses.original: καὶ φιλοτιμεῖσθαι ἡσυχάζειν καὶ πράσσειν τὰ ἴδια καὶ ἐργάζεσθαι ταῖς ἰδίαις χερσὶν ὑμῶν καθὼς ὑμῖν παρηγγείλαμεν
verses.transliteration: kai philotimeisthai hēsychazein kai prassein ta idia kai ergazesthai tais idiais chersin hymōn kathōs hymin parēngeilamen
verses.literal: and to aspire to live quietly to attend to your own matters and to work with your own hands as we instructed you

verses.original: ἵνα περιπατῆτε εὐσχημόνως πρὸς τοὺς ἔξω καὶ μηδενὸς χρείαν ἔχητε
verses.transliteration: hina peripatēte euschēmonōs pros tous exō kai mēdenos chreian echēte
verses.literal: Then you will behave properly toward outsiders without being dependent on anyone

verses.original: Οὐ θέλομεν δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν ἀδελφοί περὶ τῶν κοιμωμένων ἵνα μὴ λυπῆσθε καθὼς καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ οἱ μὴ ἔχοντες ἐλπίδα
verses.transliteration: Ou thelomen de hymas agnoein adelphoi peri tōn koimōmenōn hina mē lypēsthe kathōs kai hoi loipoi hoi mē echontes elpida
verses.literal: Brothers we do not want you to be uninformed about those who sleep in death so that you will not grieve like . . . the rest who are without hope

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ πιστεύομεν ὅτι Ἰησοῦς ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἀνέστη οὕτως καὶ ὁ Θεὸς τοὺς κοιμηθέντας διὰ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἄξει σὺν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: ei gar pisteuomen hoti Iēsous apethanen kai anestē houtōs kai ho Theos tous koimēthentas dia tou Iēsou axei syn autō
verses.literal: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him

verses.original: Τοῦτο γὰρ ὑμῖν λέγομεν ἐν λόγῳ Κυρίου ὅτι ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες οἱ περιλειπόμενοι εἰς τὴν παρουσίαν τοῦ Κυρίου οὐ μὴ φθάσωμεν τοὺς κοιμηθέντας
verses.transliteration: Touto gar hymin legomen en logō Kyriou hoti hēmeis hoi zōntes hoi perileipomenoi eis tēn parousian tou Kyriou ou mē phthasōmen tous koimēthentas
verses.literal: By the word of the Lord we declare to you that we who are alive and remain until the coming of the Lord will by no means precede those who have fallen asleep

verses.original: ὅτι αὐτὸς ὁ Κύριος ἐν κελεύσματι ἐν φωνῇ ἀρχαγγέλου καὶ ἐν σάλπιγγι Θεοῦ καταβήσεται ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ καὶ οἱ νεκροὶ ἐν Χριστῷ ἀναστήσονται πρῶτον
verses.transliteration: hoti autos ho Kyrios en keleusmati en phōnē archangelou kai en salpingi Theou katabēsetai ap’ ouranou kai hoi nekroi en Christō anastēsontai prōton
verses.literal: For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a loud command with the voice of an archangel and with the trumpet of God and the dead in Christ will be the first to rise . . .

verses.original: ἔπειτα ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες οἱ περιλειπόμενοι ἅμα σὺν αὐτοῖς ἁρπαγησόμεθα ἐν νεφέλαις εἰς ἀπάντησιν τοῦ Κυρίου εἰς ἀέρα καὶ οὕτως πάντοτε σὺν Κυρίῳ ἐσόμεθα
verses.transliteration: epeita hēmeis hoi zōntes hoi perileipomenoi hama syn autois harpagēsometha en nephelais eis apantēsin tou Kyriou eis aera kai houtōs pantote syn Kyriō esometha
verses.literal: After that we who are alive and remain will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air And so we will always be with the Lord

verses.original: Ὥστε παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους ἐν τοῖς λόγοις τούτοις
verses.transliteration: Hōste parakaleite allēlous en tois logois toutois
verses.literal: Therefore encourage one another with these words
